questions.question: Which service lets you manage on-premises servers and servers in other clouds with Azure tools?
questions.explanation: Arc extends Azure management outside Azure.

questions.question: Which TWO resource types can Azure Arc manage?
questions.explanation: Arc manages servers, Kubernetes, data services and more.

questions.question: Does Azure Arc migrate workloads into Azure?

options.text: No, it manages them where they run

questions.explanation: Arc projects external resources into ARM for management.
